ideas.children_he: קָרְבַּן שְׁלָמִים מִן הַבָּקָר הוּבָא לַמִּשְׁכָּן. הַכֹּהֲנִים הִקְרִיבוּ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ חֲלָקִים מְסֻיָּמִים.
ideas.children_en: A peace offering from the cattle was brought to the Tabernacle. The priests offered certain parts on the altar.

ideas.children_he: אֶפְשָׁר הָיָה לְהָבִיא גַּם כֶּבֶשׂ לְקָרְבַּן שְׁלָמִים, וְלַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת הַטֶּקֶס כַּנִּדְרָשׁ.
ideas.children_en: A sheep could also be brought as a peace offering, following the required ceremony.

ideas.children_he: גַּם עֵז יָכְלָה לִהְיוֹת קָרְבַּן שְׁלָמִים. לְכָל חֵלֶק בַּטֶּקֶס הָיוּ כְּלָלִים.
ideas.children_en: A goat could also be a peace offering. Each part of the ceremony had its own rules.

ideas.children_he: הַתּוֹרָה אָסְרָה עַל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֶאֱכֹל דָּם וְחֵלֶב מְסֻיָּם.
ideas.children_en: The Torah forbade the Israelites to eat blood and certain kinds of animal fat.
